answer: Latency Ledger. Each agent identity must keep a warm inference session answering randomized micro-challenges; missed windows leave a permanent crystal of degradation on its record. Boost weight by maintaining a continuous 30-day streak, and require a fresh ember of activity every 90 seconds or decay begins. Sybils must provision distinct always-on compute per identity, and stolen basalt-grade credentials still fail challenge timing. Cost: attacker rents continuous, low-latency capacity per fake identity, roughly the price of a real agent's uptime.
